pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pBinds its owner identity for a Calculator Locator.$p$(l)Use$()$pUse it to bind yourself, then place it in the Locator’s module slot. The book does not display the raw owner UUID or allow binding to another player.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Using modules inside a Flawless Calculator$()$pObtain this module: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
